harness.delta: H1 must prove historical signal conservation or supported intentional change before H2/H3 one-module dissolution. Current OPEN GWT, SELF-BODY-GOALS, replay, ablation and performance packages are directly implicated.

counterhypotheses: Historical signal richness may be decorative and safely compressible.
Per-channel Thalamus state may not affect Frank-level outcomes.
A single calibrated reward/persistence controller may match richer NAcc decomposition.
Five-dimensional E-PQ may be reducible without measurable loss.
ResponseAnalyzer self-feedback may be harmful drift rather than useful closure.
Historical asynchronous loops may be service-topology artifacts reproducible by event-driven one-module scheduling.
